name: Account Recovery
summary: Restores access to an existing durable identity through enumeration-resistant request handling, approved proof, replacement credentials, security cleanup, and fresh sign-in.

entryPredicate.expression: recovery-state in [none,expired,failed,completed] and a person requests recovery for an existing durable identity

completionPredicate.expression: recovery-state == completed and durable-identity == resolved and replacement-credential-established == true and prior sessions are revoked and session-capability == anonymous
